title: Field-scale PINNs for groundwater: Bayesian optimisation and FiLM modulation
description: Code accompanying the manuscript 'Scaling PINNs for Field-Scale Hydrogeology: Comparative Analysis of Bayesian Optimization and FiLM Modulation'. Physics-informed neural networks for joint groundwater-head prediction and inverse estimation of anisotropic hydraulic conductivity and storage; compares a baseline PINN, an Optuna-optimised PINN and a FiLM-conditioned PINN. Field data are not included (restricted); a synthetic data generator with the same schema is provided.
